module: Flowgraph node "Debug Cylinder" (category repeat_instant, tags util/draw). Draws a debug cylinder (debugDrawer:drawCylinder) between posA and posB every frame. Inputs: radius (number, 1 by default), posA and posB (vec3, required), color (hidden, {r,g,b,a} 0-1, pink {0.91,0.05,0.48,0.5} by default).

work.desc: If posA and posB are set, converts the color (alpha 0.5 if absent) and draws the cylinder.
